description: This file defines and manages the lifecycle of a gateway process in a macOS application, including starting, stopping, attaching to existing instances, handling environment status, logging, and configuration. It also contains debug/testing extensions.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the lifecycle, status, and communication with a gateway process, including starting, stopping, attaching, environment checking, and logging.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Enables or disables the gateway process based on the 'active' parameter, managing process start/stop and status updates.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically enables the launch agent for the gateway if it is not already enabled and conditions permit.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the gateway process if it is desired and not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process and disables the launch agent.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Checks and updates the environment status, with controls to avoid frequent refreshes.

methods.name: refreshLog
methods.description: Refreshes the in-memory log from the gateway log file.
